scenarios.title: Afflict makes the defending player lose life when the creature becomes blocked
decisions: A attacks player B with Khenra Eternal.
B blocks Khenra Eternal with Grizzly Bears.
The afflict trigger goes on the stack and resolves; no other spells or abilities are used; combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: blocked
variants.expected: The afflict trigger fires when Khenra Eternal becomes blocked and resolves: B's life goes from 20 to 19 before combat damage. Khenra Eternal and Grizzly Bears deal 2 damage to each other and both are destroyed. B's life stays 19.

variants.label: unblocked
variants.expected: The afflict trigger does not fire. Khenra Eternal deals 2 combat damage to B, whose life goes from 20 to 18. Grizzly Bears stays on the battlefield undamaged.

scenarios.title: Two instances of afflict trigger separately
decisions: A attacks player B with Khenra Eternal (4/2 with Dagger of the Worthy attached).
B blocks Khenra Eternal with Grizzly Bears.
Both afflict triggers go on the stack and resolve; no other spells or abilities are used; combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: two_instances
variants.expected: Khenra Eternal has afflict 1 printed and afflict 1 from the Dagger, so two afflict triggers fire and resolve separately: B's life goes from 20 to 18 before combat damage. Khenra Eternal and Grizzly Bears destroy each other; B's life stays 18.

variants.label: one_instance
variants.delta: Dagger of the Worthy is on A's battlefield but not attached to Khenra Eternal.
variants.expected: Only the printed afflict triggers: B's life goes from 20 to 19. Khenra Eternal (2/2) and Grizzly Bears destroy each other; B's life stays 19.

variants.label: unblocked
variants.expected: Neither afflict trigger fires. Khenra Eternal deals 4 combat damage to B, whose life goes from 20 to 16.
